import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long x, y, n;
    static double closestDiff = 1e15; // a large number to represent infinity
    static Pair bestPair = new Pair(0, 0);

    static class Pair {
        long b, a;
        Pair(long b, long a) {
            this.b = b;
            this.a = a;
        }
    }

    static void evaluate(long b, long a) {
        double currentDiff = Math.abs((double)a / b - (double)x / y);
        if (currentDiff + 1e-15 < closestDiff) {
            closestDiff = currentDiff;
            bestPair = new Pair(b, a);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        x = sc.nextLong();
        y = sc.nextLong();
        n = sc.nextLong();

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
            long a1 = (x * b) / y;
            long a2 = a1 + 1;
            evaluate(b, a1);
            evaluate(b, a2);
        }
        System.out.println(bestPair.a + "/" + bestPair.b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
